meta.title: SCRIPE-Frontend Central Auth, Post-MFA Bridge, HMAC Session Relay & Sudo MVVM

views.label: 1. Origin Routing & HMAC Relay
views.note: Custom domains detect isExternalCustomDomain() and proxy establish/refresh/logout through HMAC-signed Next.js BFF routes.

views.label: 2. Post-MFA Bridge & Tab Isolation
views.note: ssoTwoFactorBridge and ssoHandoffDispatch route post-MFA handoff tickets while ActivePrincipal isolates multi-tab principals.

views.label: 3. Sudo 403 Retry & Split Logout
views.note: api.service expands 403 Sudo retry across revocation/downgrade codes and useAuthLogout sends split logoutScope ('app' vs 'central').

boundaries.label: Client Core Origin, Post-MFA, Principal & Sudo Security

components.label: Origin Routing Policy
components.explanation: Distinguishes auth.scripe.org, single-label workspace subdomains, and external custom domains while enforcing HTTPS on all non-localhost targets.

components.label: SSO Handoff & 2FA Bridge
components.explanation: Redeems 120s ExternalAuthHandoffTicket and bridges hybrid-2FA SSO verification on auth.scripe.org/sso/continue back to verified custom-domain /sso/callback.

components.label: Active Principal Guard
components.explanation: Detects cross-tab tenant or principal divergence between per-tab sessionStorage and persisted Zustand state.

components.label: Auth Broadcast Sync
components.explanation: Filters LOGOUT, TOKEN_REFRESHED, and IMPERSONATION events strictly by matching origin, tenant, and principalId.

components.label: Relay HMAC Signer
components.explanation: Validates Sec-Fetch-Site/Origin same-origin invariant, extracts trusted client IP and host authority, rejects placeholder secrets, and signs HMAC headers.

components.label: BFF Session Relay API
components.explanation: Mints, rotates, and clears first-party __Host-scripe_refresh_token (honoring X-Scripe-Relay-Refresh-MaxAge: 0 ephemeral staySignedIn=false sessions and fail-closed 502 on missing refresh token).

components.label: ApiService Sudo Gate
components.explanation: Intercepts 403 SudoRequired, SudoExpired, SudoSessionMismatch, SudoRevokedOrExpired, SudoPolicyDowngradeRefused, and SudoTokenInvalid to elevate and replay.

components.label: SudoVerificationModal
components.explanation: Renders global on-demand Sudo step-up UI driven by policy hierarchy and passkey/TOTP/password panels.

components.label: useAuthLogout ViewModel
components.explanation: Orchestrates app-scoped vs central SSO logout through custom-domain relay or direct API, clearing local store cleanly.

components.label: auth.scripe.org
components.explanation: Hosts /sso/continue for centralized workspace picker, hybrid-2FA challenge, and verified cross-origin handoff redirect.

components.label: api.scripe.org
components.explanation: Redeems ExternalAuthHandoffTicket, mints post-MFA handoff via PostMfaHandoffHelper, verifies HMAC relay headers, and splits scr.oidc.session.

cards.title: Post-MFA Bridge & Custom-Domain Micro-Relay
items: ssoTwoFactorBridge.ts bridges hybrid-2FA SSO verification on auth.scripe.org/sso/continue back to {ReturnOrigin}/sso/callback
Next.js /api/auth/session/{establish,refresh,logout} enforces Sec-Fetch-Site/Origin, extracts trusted Client-Ip, and honors MaxAge: 0

cards.title: Expanded Sudo Retry, Tab Isolation & Split Logout
items: api.service.ts opens <SudoVerificationModal /> cleanly across SudoRevokedOrExpired, DowngradeRefused, and TokenInvalid
ActivePrincipal + BroadcastChannel guard multi-tab tenant identity against stale cross-tab writes
useAuthLogout defaults logoutScope to 'app' so scr.oidc.session survives local tab sign-out
